workItem.title: Bridge-readiness: MIT runtime settings CLI validation host runtime preflight IAU candidate

targetGap.summary: The MIT authority can compose validation readback, runtime outcome, proof artifact, proof-out adapter, file emission, command result, and validate-plan-only facts. It still requires callers to hand-write runtime selection or runtime outcome facts. A host runtime preflight facts adapter is the next narrow unit before any real locator, OS scan, runtime execution, compare, package, release, or Marketplace work.

splitDecision.reason: Host runtime preflight facts are the smallest useful step after the pure validation command chain. The lane admits supplied public-safe candidate facts and deterministic fail-closed host rules without opening OS scanning, runtime locator invocation, runtime validation execution, compare execution, LabVIEWCLI execution, Docker orchestration, terminal process wiring, file writes, package/bin publication, release, Marketplace, or source copying.
splitDecision.hostPreflightBoundary: supplied public-safe candidate facts only; no filesystem walk, registry probe, PATH probe, environment probe, or private path discovery
splitDecision.mixedBitnessBoundary: Windows LabVIEW 2026 x64 may pair with the canonical installed x86 LabVIEWCLI surface when that is the supplied host candidate for host validation
doNotAdmitTogether: file writes by the preflight adapter
